diagnostic_readiness_evidence.rule: Derived validation is diagnostic only. It records its source cutoff and actual computation context; it cannot grant candidate or decision authority and cannot admit later source evidence.

finding_a_remediation.derived_artifact_timestamps: Trade evidence, BBO bridge, readiness and diagnostic identity are indexed only after computation and carry availability no earlier than completion. Their source receipt, source availability, continuity report time, health time and BBO receipt remain unchanged.
finding_a_remediation.consumer_behavior: Native M1 composition has no universe or candidates. Diagnostics are persisted by the fixed event deadline. If computation or persistence crosses that deadline, the origin fails closed. Supervisor validates all event input refs at the immutable cutoff; native M1 output and receipt times may advance only within the original deadline.
